prerequisites: Minimum knowledge on fundamental notions of thermodynamics, electromagnetic field theory, electric machines, constituent elements of electrical circuits and how they work.
Knowledge of the graphics symbols, specific to electrical diagrams

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire the basic knowledge of air conditioning systems, control the processes that occur during the operation of heating, ventilation, filtration and air conditioning systems, and the influence of these systems on climatic parameters.
Calculate the heat demand and fundamental electrical parameters.
Manifest a positive and respectable attitude towards the scientific field.
Optimal and creative capitalization of one's own potential in scientific activities.

Know and understand the basic functional relationships of equipment for ventilation and air conditioning systems used in industry, regardless of the energy source used and their effects on the environment.
Explain and interpret the behavior of systems.
Experimentally verify the basic relations for physical systems encountered in industrial practice.

Form skills in the electrical field, use physical and numerical modeling, size assemblies, correctly use measuring equipment, evaluate errors in experimental determinations, perform functional verification, establish and make necessary adjustments to achieve design parameters, and perform maintenance works of the installations.
Diagnosis, troubleshooting and maintenance of electrical systems and components.
Identification of the objectives to be achieved, available resources, conditions to complete them, working stages, working times, associated deadlines and risks.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of the use of industrial ventilation and air conditioning systems
Industrial ventilation systems
Fundamentals. Microclimate of industrial premises
Natural ventilation of industrial premises.
Forced local ventilation of industrial premises.
Breakdown ventilation systems for industrial premises.
Air filtration in industrial premises.
Industrial air conditioning
Physiological climatic bases of air-conditioned premises
The physiological balance of human beings in artificial environments. Climatic calculation parameters.
Industrial ventilation and air conditioning equipment
Refrigeration systems and installations for air conditioning. Constructive solutions adapted to different working conditions
Installation and operation of industrial air conditioning systems
Maintenance and repair of industrial air conditioning systems
Presentation of the laboratory, labor protection measures, organization of the laboratory activity.
Measuring devices and methods used in ventilation and air-conditioning installations use of an experimental stand and existing measuring devices in the laboratory
Experimental determination of pressure variation in air ducts
Determining the structure of an isothermal free jet
Air conditioning system with variable refrigerant volume
Complex air treatment in an air conditioning system (heating-humidification)
Evaluation test. Completion of the laboratory situation / Recovery of laboratory works
teaching_methods: presentation of the course by using video projector and blackboard
use of an experimental stand and existing measuring devices in the laboratory
assessment_rules: For a minimum promotion grade of 5, it is necessary to know the fundamental notions required in the topics without presenting detailed details on their content. For the maximum grade of 10, a thorough knowledge of the treated subjects is required. Attendance is mandatory at all laboratories; a maximum of two laboratory works can be recovered (30%); participation at laboratory hours below 70% leads to the restoration of the discipline. The minimum performance standard involves carrying out works under teacher coordination to solve specific problems of maintenance and diagnosis of ventilation and air conditioning systems.
